fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) has declined 46% from its all-time high of $2,335 on June 25 to current trading at $1,262 over four months, with an additional 8% decline on October 22 as the semiconductor index fell.
fields.summary_ko.1: Quarterly results are scheduled for October 29, with Q1 guidance of revenue $10.3–$10.8B (midpoint up 18% QoQ), data center revenue expanded to $2.98B in Q4 (1/3 of total revenue), and supply shortage expected to continue through 2027 and beyond.
